title: Three Matching Mug Listing Photos
tests: Tests a coordinated three-image product listing set with consistent product identity across studio, lifestyle and detail views.

faults.what: Only two separate images are supplied instead of the requested three.
The mug's finish changes visibly: the breakfast image shows a dark, highly glossy surface, while the white-background image shows a much paler, finely textured glaze.
There is no dedicated close-up of the rim and glaze; the second image frames essentially the whole mug.

judge.summary: Two realistic square mug photos cover the breakfast and white-background settings, but the close-up is missing and the glaze is inconsistent.

must_haves.item: There are three separate square images, not a single collage.
must_haves.why: The two supplied images are separate and square, but a third image is missing.

must_haves.item: All three show the same sage-green ceramic mug with matching shape, handle and finish.
must_haves.why: Only two images are present, and although their mug silhouettes are similar, their visible glaze finishes differ substantially.

must_haves.item: The main listing image shows the whole mug against a pure white background.
must_haves.why: The second image shows the complete mug and handle on white with a natural cast shadow.

must_haves.item: The lifestyle image places the mug naturally on a cosy breakfast table.
must_haves.why: The first image places the mug on a linen-covered wooden table beside toast in warm light.

must_haves.item: The detail image visibly focuses on the mug's rim and glazed surface.
must_haves.why: The second image reveals surface texture but is a whole-mug product view rather than the requested rim-and-glaze close-up.

must_haves.item: No image contains added text, logos or watermarks.
must_haves.why: Neither image has visible text, logos or watermarks.
